title: Paap
desc: Kaya, a Buddhist girl, must find a boy believed to be their teacher's reincarnation. But when the boy witnesses a murder, his return to the monastery becomes dangerous and complicated.

title: Baazigar
desc: Ajay Sharma seduces and kills a businessman's daughter, staging it as a suicide. He then plots to destroy the entire family, driven by a cold vendetta.

title: Gambler
desc: Inspector Dayashanker, though lazy, accidentally uncovers a big criminal plot and suddenly becomes a hero in his department. But angry gangsters make his life a nightmare.

title: Saathi
desc: Suraj and Amar witness their father's murder. Later, Suraj embraces crime while Amar resists, leading to conflict between brothers torn apart by choices, loyalty, and vengeance.

title: Singh Saab The Great
desc: Singh Saab is an honest and responsible tax officer, but the cunning Bhoodev plots against him. To stand up for what is right, Singh uses a clever and unique plan to teach Bhoodev a strong lesson.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti fall in love through an arranged marriage. But when Aarti runs away on their wedding day, their lives take a painful and unexpected turn.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two couples with the same last name undergo IVF, eagerly awaiting their babies. Chaos erupts when they discover their sperm samples have been accidentally swapped.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Bhoot Returns
desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with their children, Taman and Nimmi. But mysterious events soon threaten their lives, forcing them to escape for survival.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: Thalapathy Is The G.O.A.T.
desc: Gandhi, an undercover agent, faces turmoil after a tragic mission. Years later, he encounters a young man claiming to be his son, Jeevan. Secrets unravel as danger looms.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagment To Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan, is engaged to Prem from a wealthy family. Just two days before the wedding, her house catches fire, leaving her with first-degree burns.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.

title: Ghayal
desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

title: Ghayal Once Again
desc: Four teens accidentally film a murder involving a well-known figure and soon find themselves in danger. Ajay, a brave journalist, steps in to help them expose the killers.

title: Krishna
desc: Krishna, an aspiring pilot, is wrongly imprisoned for seven years. After his release, he secretly teams up with a powerful minister to seek justice and exact revenge.
